title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE TE MIVITA RESIDENCE
description_sq:
APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE TE MIVITA RESIDENCE
Prane rruges Dritan Hoxha dhe Ish fushes se Aviacionit te Mivita Residence ofrohet apartament 2+1+2 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te nje ndertimi te ri ne faze tulle i cili perfundon ne fund te 2026. Organizohet ne: korridor, dy dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, dy tualete, ballkon. Objekti izolohet nga fasada e ventiluar. Mundesi ideale banimi dhe investimi.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE IN MIVITA RESIDENCE
description_en: 2+1+2 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN MIVITA RESIDENCE Near Dritan Hoxha Street and the Former Aviation Field in Mivita Residence, a 2+1+2 apartment is offered for sale. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a new brick building which will be completed at the end of 2026. It is organized in: corridor, two bedrooms, living room with kitchen, two toilets, balcony. The object is insulated by the ventilated facade. Ideal residential and investment opportunity. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
